note: Small CCC-era campground below Mount Mansfield on VT 108, 6.5 miles up from Stowe Village, with trails to the Mansfield ridge. Many tent sites are walk-in; the five RV sites are on the campground loop. Black bears are active daily: food and scented items go in a vehicle or bear canister. --Claude
